lines.text: The LORD tells Moses that Aaron and his sons must treat the sacred offerings with respect, or unclean ones are cut off.
A man who touches something unclean stays unclean until evening and must bathe with water before eating the sacred offerings.
Someone who eats a sacred offering in error must add a third to its value and give it to the priest.
A burnt offering must be an unblemished male, and nothing blind, injured, or maimed may be put on the altar.
A newborn ox, sheep, or goat must stay with its mother for ten days before it is acceptable as an offering.
